directory.boards_note: Only boards where you currently hold a seat appear here. Their rooms remain private.
directory.lede: Find a place to talk, attend a hearing or join your institution. Rooms support text, voice and video.
directory.no_rooms: No rooms in this section. Try another kind of room or another place.
directory.pick_place_a: Choose a place from the world browser, then open

directory.title: Live rooms
halls.about: Testimony is your own statement entered into the record — you can seal only your own posts, only in the halls. A sealed record is immutable and appealable; corrections append a new record rather than rewriting the old one.
halls.filing_uses_after: — it seals YOUR post into the append-only register; you can only file your own.
halls.intro_after: seals it into the append-only public record (Art. II §2) — the post stays in the conversation; the civic act lands immutably on the chain.
halls.intro_before: The halls are where residents deliberate on bills, referendums, petitions, and committees. Filing your own post as
halls.posting_body: Deliberating in the halls requires an active jurisdictional association (R-03) — Art. I.
home.about: The post-login home (WF-CIV-02): every live proceeding in your association chain — elections, chamber sessions, petitions, referendums — plus the community calendar and the public record. You can watch every public proceeding; you speak, testify, and vote where you live.
home.calendar_empty: Nothing on the calendar yet — scheduled sessions and election dates appear here the moment they are set.
home.calendar_lede: What's coming up in the places you belong to.
home.galleries_open: The galleries stay open, and anything that starts will appear here.
home.intro: Everything live in the places you live, each one a tap away.
home.my_record_lede: Your public civic record — it travels with any future candidacy.
home.no_claim_body: You have not said where you live yet. Declare the smallest boundary you live inside; every enclosing level associates automatically once your presence pattern verifies — and voting and candidacy unlock with it.
home.nothing_live: Nothing is live in your places right now
home.qualifying_label: Qualifying days toward the residency threshold
home.rail: You watch everything; you act where you reside. A ballot row shows only that voting is open — never how you voted.
home.record_empty: No public-record entries in your places yet — every act, vote, and minute publishes here the moment it happens.
home.residency_cite: Residency verified → all associations → rights unlocked · Art. I · CLK-05
home.rights_cite: Voting and candidacy — no other requirements · Art. I; Art. V §1
home.rights_nonvoter: Voting and candidacy unlock automatically the moment residency verifies — jurisdictional residency is the only requirement, ever. No identity check, course, or fee can be added between you and your rights.
home.rights_voter: Living here is the only requirement — these unlocked the moment your residency was confirmed, in every place that contains your home.
home.verified_associated: Residency verified — you are associated at {count} nesting level{plural}.
identity_verification.about: WF-CIV-01 identity step, Phase A scope: the manual attestation-request stub only. Per-jurisdiction external ID bridges (encrypted yes/no document match, nothing stored) arrive with federation in Phase F; an officer recording the verified flag is later-phase machinery.
identity_verification.auto_before: One day, where a jurisdiction supports it, you'll be able to link an existing government ID by an encrypted yes/no match — the document number never stored, never transmitted by us.
identity_verification.auto_bridge: : the bridge is built with federation in
identity_verification.auto_none_yet: No jurisdiction on this world can do that yet
identity_verification.auto_until: . Until then the in-person attestation request above is the only path, and it too is entirely optional.
identity_verification.banner_body: Voting and candidacy depend on jurisdictional residency alone — no identity check, document, course, or fee can ever be added between you and your rights. Skipping this page is always allowed and changes nothing.
identity_verification.banner_title: Verification is never a rights requirement.
identity_verification.intro_after: required. Voting and candidacy come from living somewhere, nothing else. You can
identity_verification.intro_before: Where your jurisdiction supports it, you can link a government ID (formally: identity verification) to your account. It helps keep elections honest — it is
identity_verification.intro_link: skip straight to saying where you live
identity_verification.manual_path: The manual path: request an attestation appointment with
identity_verification.not_verified: Not verified — and that is fine
identity_verification.office_unscoped: your jurisdiction's administrative office — you have not declared residency yet, so the request is recorded unscoped;
identity_verification.officer_records: An officer records only the verified flag — no document data is ever accepted, transmitted, or stored by this filing.
identity_verification.pending_note: A request from {when} is already on your record — requesting again simply appends a fresh entry.
identity_verification.rejected_after: — the rejection itself is on the audit chain (append-only).
identity_verification.rejected_title: Filing rejected by the constitutional engine
identity_verification.status_cite: Identity verification strengthens election integrity — never a voting requirement · Art. I; Art. II §2
journey.earn_default: the places this journey touches will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
journey.intro: Follow the real thing as it moves through the world. Each step tells you what happens, what your part is, and where to go. Mark a step when you have done it.
journey.marked_done: Step marked done — saved to your progress.
journey.medal_never: A medal never changes a vote, a seat, or what you are allowed to do.
journey.not_live: This journey is not live in this world yet. Its steps are shown for reading and cannot be marked.
journey.on_profile: This journey is on your profile:
journey.progress_yours: Your progress is yours alone. It is saved for you and does not change what the world does.
journey.read_without_account: You can read every step without an account.
journey.sign_in_save: Sign in to save your progress.
my_record.about: One person, one profile (profile-v2 contract). The Record tab is a read-only slice of the append-only audit chain (WF-SYS-03/04) filtered to your own filings; the Settings tab files F-IND-002 through the constitutional engine so the mutation and its chain entry commit together. A candidacy is a tab of this same profile — never a separate identity.
my_record.achievements_note: Earned records of the journeys you complete and your civic firsts. None ever changes a vote, a seat, or what you are allowed to do.
my_record.associations_caption: Active jurisdictional associations at every nesting level
my_record.ballots_tail: cast on your record. Your ballot only ever shows that voting is open — never how you voted.
my_record.candidacy_not_separate: A candidacy is not a separate identity: it is this same profile, carried onto the ballot.
my_record.filing_rejected_title: Filing rejected by the constitutional engine
my_record.intro: Everything about your civic life in one place — who you are, your record, the people who represent you, and (when you stand) your candidacy. Ballot choices and raw ping locations are never here: they are structurally never written to the chain.
my_record.languages_hint: Records are translated per your selection.
my_record.multiwinner: Multi-winner seats answer to every resident · Art. II §2
my_record.never_contains: Never contains ballot content or raw locations — they are never written · Art. II · WF-SYS-04
my_record.no_associations_lead: None yet — associations at every nesting level appear here the moment residency verifies.
my_record.no_entries: No entries yet — your first filing (account creation) appears here as soon as the chain records it.
my_record.no_reps: No representatives seated yet — they appear here the moment a legislature is seated for a place you live.
my_record.nothing_yet_lead: Nothing here yet — finish your first
my_record.office_elected: Elected by every resident of {jurisdiction} — this seat answers to all of them equally, never to a party or a donor.
my_record.office_note_lead: Every act you take in office is public and uneditable — it lives on your
my_record.office_note_tail: and in the institution’s own records · Art. II
my_record.one_residency: One verified residency → associations at every enclosing level · Art. I
my_record.participation_secret: Participation is public; ballot choices are secret · Art. II §2
my_record.record_is_chain: The record IS the chain — it cannot be quietly edited.
my_record.record_meta_lead: Append-only · hash-chained · shown in your timezone (
my_record.record_rides: The record rides along — it is the Record tab of this same profile · Art. II
my_record.rejection_audit: {reason} — the rejection itself is on the audit chain (append-only).
my_record.reps_gloss: Seats are elected in multi-winner rounds, so several people represent you at once — every one of them answers to you, including the ones you didn\
my_record.rights_derive: Rights derive from residency alone · Art. I; Art. V §1
my_record.settings_note: Self-managed, no civic weight — only the fields that actually changed are filed, and only those ever appear on the chain.
my_record.speaker: Speaker
my_record.timezone_hint: Dates are shown in your timezone · stored as UTC.
my_record.wallet_gloss: Your balance, transfers, and holdings live on the wallet page.
my_record.wallet_private: Private — like a ballot, only you can read it.
petition_detail.adopted_scale: adopted across the scale if passed · act type: {type}
petition_detail.appended: Your signature is appended to the record
petition_detail.audit_below: below the {threshold} threshold (kill-path: too many invalid → invalidated).
petition_detail.audit_cite: independent audit · an R-08 action surfaced read-only here · Art. II §6 · CLK-17
petition_detail.audit_completed: Completed {when} by the {board} · stored as UTC.
petition_detail.audit_empty: The election board's independent audit runs when the threshold is reached — every unrevoked signature is verified against point-in-time association. Kill-path: too many invalid → invalidated.
petition_detail.audit_invalidated: Audit complete — below threshold, petition invalidated
petition_detail.ballot_after: at the threshold matching the act type (WF-ELE-07) — absent voters count exactly like a no.
petition_detail.frozen_title: audited count frozen at the threshold check
petition_detail.intro: A citizen-drafted law at {name} scale, created by {creator}. A petition can be stopped two ways: a failed signature audit, or a finding that the proposed law is unconstitutional.
petition_detail.law_text_note: This is the binding text voters ratify — not a summary.
petition_detail.lifecycle_cite: Created → … → Constitutional-Review → Validated → On-Ballot · Art. II §6
petition_detail.review_cite: petitions invalidated if unconstitutional · Art. II §6 · WF-JUD-09
petition_detail.review_empty: Review follows a passed signature audit. If the proposed law unjustly impedes rights, the petition is invalidated; otherwise it is validated for the next jurisdiction-wide ballot.
petition_detail.review_stub_advanced: Advanced past the review hold by the audited Phase C stub — recorded on the chain with the deferral citation; the real F-JDG-008 referral lands with the judiciary (Phase E).
petition_detail.review_stub_pending: Constitutional review · awaiting judiciary (Planned · Phase E). Petitions at this stage hold until review exists; the kill-path is constitutional, not skippable.
petition_detail.scope_cite: scale & scope travel with the law · Art. II §6; Art. V §4
petition_detail.sig_cite: available to R-03 Jurisdictionally Associated · Art. II §6
petition_detail.sig_form_after: — signatures stay open during review; the audited count is frozen at the threshold check.
petition_detail.threshold_line: threshold {count} = {pct}% of the civic population snapshot ({basis}) · CLK-17
petitions.about: Signing (F-IND-010) is available to any R-03 associated resident of the petition's jurisdiction — no petitioner role needed to sign. Thresholds are snapshots: the civic-population basis and the resolved percentage freeze at creation (CLK-17).
petitions.avail_cite: available to R-03 Jurisdictionally Associated · Art. II §6
petitions.creation_body: Creating a petition requires an active jurisdictional association (R-03) — the same gate as voting and candidacy, and the only one (Art. I).
petitions.frozen_title: audited count frozen at the threshold check
petitions.intro: Anyone who lives here can draft a law and put it to a vote. Reach the signature threshold, pass an independent check and a constitutionality review, and your proposal goes on the next jurisdiction-wide ballot.
petitions.law_text_hint: Write the binding text itself, not a summary — this is what voters ratify. It is reviewed for constitutionality before ballot placement.
petitions.lifecycle_cite: Audit by the election board (F-ELB-005) · review by the judiciary (F-JDG-008 · Planned · Phase E) · Art. II §6
petitions.scale_hint: ≈ {count} signatures at {name}'s civic population of {population} ({pct}% · CLK-17 — snapshot taken at creation)
petitions.scale_hint_default: Threshold preview updates with your selection.
petitions.scale_scope_a: Scale and scope travel with the law — the same fields a bill carries. The petition enters at
petitions.sign_toggles: The Sign toggles use Petition signature
petitions.sign_toggles_after: — revocable while the petition gathers; the audited count freezes at the threshold check.
petitions.title_placeholder: Short, neutral title for the proposed law
petitions.two_kill_paths: Two kill-paths: a failed signature audit, or an unconstitutional finding.
private_room.add_leave_note: Anyone here can add or leave at any time. When the last person leaves, the conversation is gone.
private_room.channel_not_up: The live channel for this room isn’t up yet — try again shortly.
private_room.locked_body: You need an invite to join. Ask whoever shared it to send you a fresh link.
private_room.offline_suffix: — this room is offline right now
private_room.text_voice_note: Text and voice/video are live here; file attachments aren’t wired yet.
public_square.about: Reactions, follows, and per-user blocks stay local to your device and never federate. A post can be removed only under a logged carve-out (a judicial order, or protecting another's rights) — every such removal is itself a public, appealable record.
public_square.intro: The public square is open to every resident of the jurisdiction. Anyone associated may post; no one — operator, legislator, or judge — may remove a post on viewpoint. The only removals are four narrow, logged carve-outs (Art. I).
public_square.no_threads: No threads yet — any associated resident can open one.
public_square.posting_body: Posting in the square requires an active jurisdictional association (R-03) — the same gate as voting, and the only one (Art. I).
reach.activating_body: Too few people have verified here to show a number safely — publishing it could point at individual people. The gauge appears once enough residents have joined.
reach.capped_note: More people have verified here than the estimate allows for — the estimate lags this place. The true figure is {figure}%.
reach.count_hidden_body: The count stays hidden while it is small, so this page cannot say how many more are needed without revealing how many are already here.
reach.gates_a: This gates only when a government may
reach.gates_b: — never anyone's vote or right to stand for office. Those need residency and nothing else.
reach.gauge_banner: A gauge, never a lever — reach changes no vote, no seat and no right. Only places are measured, never people. It is not the Art. VI §3 legitimacy verdict, which is a question about allegiance and restoration, not a headcount.
reach.gov_start_title: When can a government start here?
reach.intro: How many of the people who live in a place have verified their residency here. A signal of how alive a place is, and nothing more.
reach.meter_label: Verified residents as a share of the population estimate
reach.over_time_note: Nightly snapshots. On any night the count was too small to be safe, the curve simply stops rather than showing a zero.
reach.threshold_disabled: Thresholds are not switched on in this world yet — a single verified resident is enough to start a government.
reach.threshold_enabled: The threshold comes from the population: about the cube root of how many people live here, held between {floor} and {cap}.
reach.unmeasurable_body: There is no population estimate for this place yet, so reach cannot be measured. That is not the same as nobody living here.
relocation.about_a: No forms on this surface: the move path reuses Residency declaration (F-IND-003) on
relocation.about_b: ; "I'm travelling" is an audited engine action, not a catalog form.
relocation.away_banner_body: Detection uses the same encrypted ping log as verification; only day-counts are visible.
relocation.away_note: A move only completes when the away-pattern reaches the full residency threshold — the same standard your home verification used.
relocation.detect_empty_a: This card will light up when sustained pings appear outside your declared jurisdiction — but nothing is watching for that yet: automatic away-detection needs the mobile geofenced pinging that arrives in
relocation.detect_empty_b: . Until then, if you move, you tell us yourself below. When it does exist it will read the same encrypted ping log verification uses — only day-counts ever visible, pings always pausable.
relocation.grace_meter: day {day} of {of} — grace ends if the move completes
relocation.grace_meter_label: Grace period — the new claim's CLK-05 threshold
relocation.held_offices_body: An office tied to a jurisdiction is not dropped the instant you move — the grace period lets the institution prepare while you remain accountable.
relocation.held_offices_title: Held offices and the grace period
relocation.intro: Your residency follows where you actually live. When a sustained presence pattern forms outside your home jurisdiction, the system asks — it never reassigns you silently, and it never penalizes travel.
relocation.lifecycle_body: Your old residency claim becomes Superseded only when the new one verifies —
relocation.lifecycle_title: Where you are in the residency lifecycle
relocation.moving_note: Moving: a new residency declaration (F-IND-003 on the residency screen) alongside your active claim IS the move — no new form exists here, by design.
relocation.never_gap: there is never a gap in your rights
relocation.new_claim_note: the constitutional grace IS this threshold · CLK-05
relocation.no_move: No move in flight — nothing changes
relocation.no_office: You hold no office tied to your home jurisdiction — nothing to hand over
relocation.reassoc_note: If re-association completes, the seat is declared vacant (F-LEG-036, system-filed) and fills by countback (WF-ELE-03) — prior ballots re-run with the vacated member removed. If you stay, nothing changes.
relocation.stays_active_b: (Superseded-pending) until this claim verifies — the hand-over is atomic at verification.
relocation.step1_action: Declare residency in the new jurisdiction
relocation.step2_outcome: Old associations remain fully active until then — no gap in voting or candidacy.
relocation.step3_action: Associations transfer; held offices resolve via the grace period
relocation.step3_outcome: Old roles gracefully expire; a held seat vacates into countback (F-LEG-036 → WF-ELE-03); federation peers are notified.
relocation.title_moved: It looks like you may have moved
relocation.travel_or_move_body: Tell the system which this is. Either answer is final only when you say so — and a move still requires the full threshold pattern before anything transfers.
relocation.travelling_detection: Travelling: detection resets, nothing changes — pings pausable in personal settings; the declaration is audit-chained (WF-CIV-03).
relocation.travelling_none: Travelling: no away-pattern has been detected — nothing needs resetting — so this is a standing declaration that a future trip is travel, not a move. It is recorded on the audit chain (WF-CIV-03) and changes nothing about your residency or your rights.
relocation.vacancy_cite: Vacancy → countback → special election fallback (90–180 d · CLK-04) · Art. II §5 · Art. V §1–2
relocation.zero_gap_body: Voting, candidacy, and every association hold through the whole move
relocation.zero_gap_title: Your old claim stays Active until the new one Verifies — no rights gap, ever.
residency.about: WF-CIV-02 residency establishment — declaration, check-in monitoring, threshold, verification, and the association sweep all land on this surface. Entity machines: Residency Claim ({machine}) and Individual (R-02 → R-03).

residency.change_restart: Changing your home starts the check-in days again inside the new place.
residency.checked_in: You checked in from {home} on {days} days.
residency.checkin_body: Open this page while you are at home and check in. Each day counts once. Your location stays private; only the number of days is kept. When you reach {days} days you will be asked to confirm.
residency.checkin_note: one check-in per day, from inside {home}

residency.confirm_belong: Confirm and you belong to every place that contains it.

residency.declare_body: Use your current location, or click your home on the map. Only the place you live in is recorded, never the exact point.
residency.finding_point: Finding the place at that point…

residency.how_works_summary: How this works, and the fine print
residency.instant_note: You are confirmed the moment you declare.
residency.intro: Tell us where you live. That is the only requirement. Once your home is confirmed you belong to every place that contains it, and you can vote and stand for office in each of them.
residency.locate_not_found: Could not find a place for this point ({status}).
residency.locked_h2: You declared {home}. Now show you live there.
residency.monitored_note: Then check in from home on {days} days and you are confirmed.

residency.privacy_body: Locations are encrypted at rest, never shown to anyone, and deleted once you are confirmed. Only the number of days is ever visible.
